scenario.name: r-cd-chained-depth-2
scenario.description: Depth-2 delegate chain: parent→child→grandchild→return path. Three sub-tests: (1) up-tree silent-wake, (2) inter-session return, (3) echo+broadcast via fanoutMode.

invocation.promptTemplate: Proof chain nonce {{nonce}}: you are depth-1. Fire your own continue_delegate(mode='silent-wake', task='Grandchild nonce {{nonce}}: reply exactly GRANDCHILD-DONE {{nonce}} only after you arrive. Do not mutate files.'). After the nested continue_delegate tool result reports scheduled, reply exactly CHILD-DONE {{nonce}} CHILD-DELEGATE-SCHEDULED.

expectedReceipts.name: child-spawns
expectedReceipts.description: Post-dispatch, non-harness session event contains strict CHILD-DONE {{nonce}} CHILD-DELEGATE-SCHEDULED sentinel

expectedReceipts.name: child-fires-grandchild
expectedReceipts.description: CHILD-DONE sentinel confirms depth-1 delegate executed the nested continue_delegate instruction

expectedReceipts.name: grandchild-spawns
expectedReceipts.description: Post-dispatch, non-harness session event contains strict GRANDCHILD-DONE sentinel

expectedReceipts.name: grandchild-returns
expectedReceipts.description: A nonce-bound grandchild identity and exact GRANDCHILD-DONE sentinel are observed after dispatch acceptance

expectedReceipts.name: parent-receives-chain-return
expectedReceipts.description: The exact root session receives GRANDCHILD-DONE {{nonce}} as a structured role=system return event, bound to distinct child and grandchild identities

expectedReceipts.name: trace-id
expectedReceipts.description: Trace ID for chain visualization in Tempo

review.notes: Depth-2 chain proof. PASS-candidate requires strict child/grandchild sentinels, two distinct nonce-bound hop identities, and an explicit role=system GRANDCHILD-DONE {{nonce}} receipt in the exact root session. Grandchild assistant output alone is not return authority.

census.limits: chain.id makes the chain itself partially rebindable, but each hop’s identity is not: no exported span says which run or turn was depth-1 versus depth-2, so a later reader can see that a chain existed and cannot reconstruct its shape or which seat produced it.

spans.name: continuation.delegate.dispatch
spans.notes: One per hop; hops are not distinguishable from each other in exported attributes.

attributes.notes: Emitted today and already asserted by the row’s trace-correlation resolver. It is the strongest join currently available and it is not an identity.
Hop depth on the accepted entry span. Without it a depth-2 chain and two unrelated depth-1 dispatches look alike.
Accepted entry spans carry no signal.kind on the census product basis; origin is contracted by R-OBS-CONT-PROVENANCE.
No k6/Project-81 resource or trace marker exists, so this row’s traffic cannot be separated from organic fleet traffic in a later census.

redaction.rule: Hop identities are published as nonce-bound fingerprints. Chain task text, grandchild prompt bodies, raw session keys, and tokens never enter the artifact.

controls.positive: Strict child and grandchild sentinels are observed, two distinct nonce-bound hop identities exist, and the exact root session receives the grandchild sentinel as a structured role=system return.
controls.negative: Prompt echoes and ordinary grandchild assistant output do not satisfy the return receipt; grandchild output alone is never return authority.
controls.notes: Depth is currently established by sentinels and hop identities, not by telemetry.

backendUnavailable.notes: A degraded backend removes chain visualization only. The behavioral receipts stand on the gateway event stream and the row stays PARTIAL for the missing trace.

verdictAuthority.pass: Both hop sentinels, two distinct nonce-bound hop identities, and the explicit root-session structured return. Behavioral only.
verdictAuthority.partial: A hop identity or the trace receipt is unavailable, or the telemetry backend is degraded or partial.
verdictAuthority.fail: The root session never receives the structured grandchild return, or the two hop identities collapse into one.

execution.deterministicK6: r-cd-chained-depth-2.js fires the exact committed manifest task and asserts both hops.
execution.manual: Per-seat cross-walk runs (TEST-1/2/3) remain manual and are filed under the row’s canonical path with their substitution recorded.
execution.relationship: The deterministic row is the verdict authority for chain shape; manual cross-walks add seat coverage and never substitute for a missing hop receipt.

liveRunSafety.notes: Live depth-2 chain row. Prefer OPENCLAW_CREATE_DISPOSABLE_SESSION=true. Detector ignores prompt echoes and ordinary GRANDCHILD-DONE assistant output; PASS requires distinct hop identities plus the exact root role=system return receipt.
